source_binding: Use git log -1 --format=%H -- evidence/R6/2026-10-29/verification.json for the containing exchange commit. Final combined regression is recorded in evidence/DELIVERY/2026-10-29.
scope: LedgerOps-side selected synthetic read-only exchange v1.0/v1.1; standalone stdlib consumer, immutable golden artifacts and real full-source/R4 integration.
verification: 61 exchange/context/pin-scope test cases are part of the integrated final suite; see its JUnit results rather than treating this as a separate full run.
contracts: Explicit payout/journal selection; no database credential, callback or operational write capability; raw provider request/envelope/auth records excluded.
Opaque canonical UUIDs and lossless decimal strings for money/sequences/versions; exactPLN_minor scale2.
DeterministicUUID5 identity bound to source, selection and records digest; changed arbitrary dataset identity is rejected.
Strict versions, units, fields, source scope, references, selected arithmetic and canonical byte digests; real isolated python -I -S with one copied consumer file.
v1.0 historical golden80/80 literals; v1.1 explicitly tagged complete format10 source and full-checker declaration, not a silently enlarged legacy schema.
PinnedR4 references bind exact supportedmanifest kind/version/workspace/namespace/window/date/rules/parser/statement and source revision/digests; recomputing hashes does not bypass scope.
Local record times never substitute for unknown external execution, COMMIT or snapshotclock; nonRR maintenance captures rejected.
Original exceptions and append-only dispositions retained; unhealthy complete sources remain declared unhealthy despite a self-consistent selected subset.
limits: No Chronicle code or adapter changed; standalone compatibility protocol only.
Selected validation does not independently establish complete-ledger health, HMAC authenticity, historical grants or true original request intent.
Historical reader-pin references do not promise current pin retention/current publication.
